correctness.rationale: Exact characterization of minimum RDFs by T=f^-1(2) proves all support-set encodings. An exhaustive 2^20 dynamic mask census attains exactly weight 12 and 340 states; independent incidence-model enumeration over |T|<=6, with |T|>=7 excluded by weight >=14, reproduces them. Both independently generate or pair-classify all 540 allowed P1/P2/P3 transitions, compare full state-edge certificate, and exhaustively BFS the five 48-state components. Rotational permutation of components is explicitly checked. All packaged programs replay with matching stdout. Limits: finite graph only; no general conjecture.

value.rationale: The operational geometry of minimum Roman defensive placements is not determined by their known minimum weight. On a canonical 20-vertex distance-transitive cubic bipartite graph, the finding exhibits a nontrivial frozen/mobile separation (100 isolated minima versus five symmetry-equivalent 48-state phases), identifies the transformation operations, complete graph of feasible movements, exact radii/diameters and rotational explanation. These are natural, motivated exact reachability invariants for the first concrete middle-levels example, rather than arbitrary enumerated slices or a textbook corollary.
